core: straight line
meaning_cn: 直线；笔直的线条
explanation_cn: straight 表示不弯曲的、笔直的。straight line of his jaw 描写下颌线条笔直清晰，是外貌描写。
source_sentence: I like to admire the straight line of his jaw.

examples.en: There is a straight line between the two points.
examples.cn: 两点之间有一条直线。

examples.en: He has a straight line to his jaw.
examples.cn: 他的下颌线很直很清晰。

pronunciation.text: straight line
pronunciation.hint_cn: straight 结尾 t 可轻收，line 拉长一点。

core: curve
meaning_cn: 弧线；曲线；弯曲处
explanation_cn: curve 可以作名词表示弧线，也可作动词表示弯曲。the curve of his cheekbone 指颧骨的弧度。
source_sentence: I like to admire the curve of his cheekbone.

examples.en: The road follows the curve of the river.
examples.cn: 这条路沿着河流的弯曲走势。

examples.en: The curve of the design makes it look softer.
examples.cn: 这个设计的弧线让它看起来更柔和。

pronunciation.text: curve
pronunciation.hint_cn: 开头 c 发 /k/ 的感觉，v 要轻轻咬唇。

core: cheekbone
meaning_cn: 颧骨
explanation_cn: cheekbone 由 cheek（脸颊）+ bone（骨头）组成，指脸颊上方突出的骨头，常用于外貌描写。
source_sentence: I like to admire the curve of his cheekbone.

examples.en: She has high cheekbones.
examples.cn: 她的颧骨很高。

examples.en: The light highlighted his cheekbones.
examples.cn: 光线突出了他的颧骨。

pronunciation.text: cheekbone
pronunciation.hint_cn: cheek 和 bone 拼在一起读，cheek 稍重。

core: openness
meaning_cn: 开放感；坦率感；没有防备的感觉
explanation_cn: openness 不只是“开放”，在外貌描写中表示脸上有一种坦率、真诚、没有戒备的感觉。There is an openness to his face 表示他的脸给人一种坦诚感。
source_sentence: There’s an openness to his face.

examples.en: There is an openness to her voice.
examples.cn: 她的声音里有一种坦率感。

examples.en: The design creates a sense of openness.
examples.cn: 这个设计营造出一种开阔感。

pronunciation.text: openness
pronunciation.hint_cn: open 后接 -ness，重音在 open。

core: innocence
meaning_cn: 天真；纯真；无辜
explanation_cn: innocence 可以表示法律上的无罪，也可以表示性格或表情上的天真、纯真。小说里强调一种不世故的气质。
source_sentence: There’s an openness to his face, an innocence.

examples.en: There was a childlike innocence in his smile.
examples.cn: 他的笑里有一种孩子般的纯真。

examples.en: The evidence proved her innocence.
examples.cn: 证据证明了她的清白。

pronunciation.text: innocence
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重音在开头 in，后面轻读。

core: lacrosse
meaning_cn: 长曲棍球
explanation_cn: lacrosse 是一种团队运动，球员用带网兜的球杆接球、传球和射门。在美国高中/大学语境中常见。
source_sentence: It’s Friday night at Gabe Rivera’s house after the lacrosse game.

examples.en: He plays lacrosse after school.
examples.cn: 他放学后打长曲棍球。

examples.en: They went to a party after the lacrosse game.
examples.cn: 他们在长曲棍球比赛后去了派对。

pronunciation.text: lacrosse
pronunciation.hint_cn: la 发轻，crosse 部分读得更重。

core: haptics
meaning_cn: 触觉反馈；触觉技术
explanation_cn: haptics 常用于手机、手柄、触控设备，表示通过震动或触感让用户感知操作反馈的技术。
source_sentence: haptics

examples.en: The phone uses haptics to give feedback when you type.
examples.cn: 手机在你打字时用触觉反馈回应。

examples.en: Good haptics can make the interface feel more natural.
examples.cn: 好的触觉反馈能让界面感觉更自然。

pronunciation.text: haptics
pronunciation.hint_cn: hap 部分短促，tics 结尾读清。

core: new fiber subscribers and cable subscriber losses in 2026
meaning_cn: 2026 年新增光纤用户和流失的有线用户
explanation_cn: lossing 不是正确形式。表达“用户流失”时可用 subscriber losses；并列名词短语中保持结构一致：new fiber subscribers and cable subscriber losses。
source_sentence: new Fiber subscribers and the cable user lossing in 2026

examples.en: Do you know the number of new fiber subscribers and cable subscriber losses in H1 2026?
examples.cn: 你知道 2026 年上半年新增光纤用户和有线用户流失数量吗？

examples.en: We need to compare new fiber subscribers with cable subscriber losses.
examples.cn: 我们需要比较新增光纤用户和有线用户流失。

pronunciation.text: new fiber subscribers and cable subscriber losses
pronunciation.hint_cn: subscribers 和 losses 结尾 s 都要读出来。

core: jaw
meaning_cn: 下巴；颌部
explanation_cn: jaw 指嘴部附近负责咬合的颌部区域，也可以表示动物的上下颌，不是整个脸。
source_sentence: His jaw dropped in surprise.

examples.en: His jaw dropped in surprise.
examples.cn: 他惊讶得下巴都掉下来了。

examples.en: The dentist checked my jaw.
examples.cn: 牙医检查了我的颌部。

pronunciation.text: jaw
pronunciation.hint_cn: j 发类似“知”的开头音，aw 拉成长一点。

core: be concerned with
meaning_cn: 与……有关；关注的是……；从事的是……
explanation_cn: be concerned with 强调讨论、研究、工作或关注的对象；不要误解成 concerned about 的“担心”。
source_sentence: people who have been concerned with matters of consequence

examples.en: This report is mainly concerned with fiber user growth.
examples.cn: 这份报告主要关注光纤用户增长。

examples.en: The meeting was concerned with customer migration plans.
examples.cn: 这次会议讨论的是客户迁移计划。

pronunciation.text: be concerned with
pronunciation.hint_cn: concerned 重音在第二部分；with 可以弱读。

core: matters of consequence
meaning_cn: 重要的事情；有分量的事务
explanation_cn: consequence 在这里不是“后果”，而是“重要性、影响力”。matters of consequence 指那些被认为严肃、重要、有社会分量的事。
source_sentence: people who have been concerned with matters of consequence

examples.en: They only talk about matters of consequence.
examples.cn: 他们只谈所谓重要的大事。

examples.en: For the customer, network migration is a matter of consequence.
examples.cn: 对客户来说，网络迁移是一件重要的事。

pronunciation.text: matters of consequence
pronunciation.hint_cn: consequence 重音在开头部分。

core: a great many
meaning_cn: 很多；大量
explanation_cn: a great many 后面接可数名词复数，比 many 更强调数量多，语气稍正式或文学化。
source_sentence: I have had a great many encounters with a great many people.

examples.en: We have seen a great many changes this year.
examples.cn: 今年我们看到了很多变化。

examples.en: A great many users are moving from cable to fiber.
examples.cn: 很多用户正在从有线迁移到光纤。

pronunciation.text: a great many
pronunciation.hint_cn: great many 连读时不要逐词太重。

core: close at hand
meaning_cn: 近在眼前；就在身边；很近
explanation_cn: close at hand 既可以表示空间距离很近，也可以表示时间上即将发生。小说里强调“近距离地、亲眼地观察”。
source_sentence: I have seen them intimately, close at hand.

examples.en: Help is close at hand.
examples.cn: 帮助就在身边。

examples.en: The deadline is close at hand.
examples.cn: 截止日期马上就到了。

pronunciation.text: close at hand
pronunciation.hint_cn: close 这里读形容词的读法，不是动词 close the door。

core: That hasn't much improved my opinion of them.
meaning_cn: 这并没有让我对他们的看法改善多少。
explanation_cn: not much improved 表示“没有改善多少”。opinion of them 是“对他们的看法”。这句话带有轻微讽刺，意思是近距离接触成年人后，评价也没有变好。
source_sentence: And that hasn't much improved my opinion of them.

examples.en: That hasn't changed my opinion of the plan.
examples.cn: 那并没有改变我对这个计划的看法。

examples.en: The new data hasn't much improved my view of the market.
examples.cn: 新数据并没有让我对市场的看法改善多少。

pronunciation.text: That hasn't much improved my opinion of them.
pronunciation.hint_cn: hasn't much improved 中 much 起强调作用；of them 中 of 弱读。

core: clear-sighted
meaning_cn: 有眼光的；看问题清楚的；头脑清醒的
explanation_cn: clear-sighted 不是单纯“视力好”，而是形容人判断清楚、有洞察力。
source_sentence: Whenever I met one of them who seemed to me at all clear-sighted...

examples.en: She is a clear-sighted manager.
examples.cn: 她是一个很有判断力的管理者。

examples.en: We need a clear-sighted view of the competition.
examples.cn: 我们需要对竞争有清醒的判断。

pronunciation.text: clear-sighted
pronunciation.hint_cn: clear 和 sighted 分开读，sighted 重音较弱。

core: at all
meaning_cn: 稍微；哪怕一点；到底，用于加强语气
explanation_cn: at all 常和否定、疑问或条件语境连用。这里 seemed to me at all clear-sighted 的意思是“只要在我看来稍微有点眼光”。
source_sentence: Whenever I met one of them who seemed to me at all clear-sighted...

examples.en: If you need any help at all, let me know.
examples.cn: 只要你需要任何帮助，就告诉我。

examples.en: I don't understand it at all.
examples.cn: 我完全不理解。

pronunciation.text: at all
pronunciation.hint_cn: 两个短词常连读，all 稍重。

core: try the experiment of doing something
meaning_cn: 尝试做某事来验证；做一个……的实验
explanation_cn: try the experiment of doing something 表示用某个动作来测试对方反应或验证判断，比 simply try doing 更有“试验”的意味。
source_sentence: I tried the experiment of showing him my Drawing Number One.

examples.en: We tried the experiment of showing customers two package options.
examples.cn: 我们尝试给客户展示两个套餐选项来验证反应。

examples.en: She tried the experiment of reading aloud every day.
examples.cn: 她尝试每天朗读来验证效果。

pronunciation.text: try the experiment of doing something
pronunciation.hint_cn: experiment 重音在第二部分。

core: We are preparing to return to China in October.
meaning_cn: 我们正准备十月份回中国。
explanation_cn: prepare return to China 不自然，应该说 prepare to return to China 或 be preparing to return to China。China 不是 chain。
source_sentence: Not yet. But we prepare return to chain in October.

examples.en: Not yet, but we are preparing to return to China in October.
examples.cn: 还没有，但我们正准备十月份回中国。

examples.en: We are planning to return to China in October.
examples.cn: 我们计划十月份回中国。

pronunciation.text: We are preparing to return to China in October.
pronunciation.hint_cn: preparing to 可连读，return to 中 to 弱读。

core: Is this related to the process?
meaning_cn: 这和流程有关吗？
explanation_cn: related 是形容词，前面需要 be 动词。不能说 does this related，应该说 Is this related to...? 更自然。
source_sentence: What's the problem? Does this related to the process?

examples.en: Is this related to the visa process?
examples.cn: 这和签证流程有关吗？

examples.en: Could you let me know if this is related to the process?
examples.cn: 你能告诉我这是否和流程有关吗？

pronunciation.text: Is this related to the process?
pronunciation.hint_cn: related 重音在第二部分；to 可弱读。

core: It should be ready before the middle of this month.
meaning_cn: 它应该会在本月中旬之前准备好。
explanation_cn: should be ready 表示根据对方说法或预期“应该会好”。before the middle of this month 是“本月中旬之前”。
source_sentence: They told the lawyers that it should be ready before the middle of this month.

examples.en: The document should be ready before Friday.
examples.cn: 文件应该会在周五之前准备好。

examples.en: The approval should be ready before the middle of this month.
examples.cn: 审批应该会在本月中旬之前完成。

pronunciation.text: It should be ready before the middle of this month.
pronunciation.hint_cn: should be 可连读，ready 稍重。

core: The mistake was made by the Panama Migration Office.
meaning_cn: 这个错误是巴拿马移民局造成的。
explanation_cn: 表达“错误由某方造成”时，更自然的是 The mistake was made by...。office 前通常需要 the，专有机构名称可大写。
source_sentence: The mistake was from Panama Migration office.

examples.en: The mistake was made by the immigration office.
examples.cn: 这个错误是移民办公室造成的。

examples.en: It was not our mistake.
examples.cn: 这不是我们的错误。

pronunciation.text: The mistake was made by the Panama Migration Office.
pronunciation.hint_cn: mistake 和 Migration 都要读清楚。

core: keep waiting
meaning_cn: 继续等待；一直等下去
explanation_cn: keep doing 表示持续做某事。keep waiting 带有“还得继续等、暂时没有结果”的感觉。
source_sentence: They told us we have to keep waiting.

examples.en: We have to keep waiting for the approval.
examples.cn: 我们还得继续等审批。

examples.en: The customer cannot keep waiting forever.
examples.cn: 客户不可能一直等下去。

pronunciation.text: keep waiting
pronunciation.hint_cn: keep 和 waiting 都读清楚，waiting 的 t 不要读太重。

core: We'd like to focus on FTTH.
meaning_cn: 我们想重点关注 FTTH。
explanation_cn: We'd like to focus on... 是自然、克制的商务表达，用来说明关注重点或讨论范围。
source_sentence: We'd like to focus on FTTH.

examples.en: We'd like to focus on fiber growth this month.
examples.cn: 这个月我们想重点关注光纤增长。

examples.en: For this analysis, we'd like to focus on FTTH users only.
examples.cn: 本次分析我们只想关注 FTTH 用户。

pronunciation.text: We'd like to focus on FTTH.
pronunciation.hint_cn: We'd like to 连读，FTTH 按字母读。

core: including other networks
meaning_cn: 包括其他网络在内；包含其他网络
explanation_cn: including 用来补充范围。对方说 including other networks I don't know，意思大概是“是否包含其他网络我不知道”，表达上可以拆成 I don't know whether it includes other networks.
source_sentence: FTTH, including other networks I dont know.

examples.en: I don't know whether this number includes other networks.
examples.cn: 我不知道这个数字是否包含其他网络。

examples.en: The data includes all FTTH users.
examples.cn: 这个数据包含所有 FTTH 用户。

pronunciation.text: including other networks
pronunciation.hint_cn: including 重音在第二部分；networks 结尾 s 要带出来。

core: The information is managed at the CXO level.
meaning_cn: 这个信息由 CXO 层面掌握或管理。
explanation_cn: 表示“在某个层级”通常用 at the ... level，不用 in ... level。商务表达中可说 The information is managed at the CXO level。
source_sentence: Information is managed in CXO level.

examples.en: The information is managed at the CXO level.
examples.cn: 这个信息由 CXO 层面掌握。

examples.en: This decision is made at the regional level.
examples.cn: 这个决定是在区域层面做出的。

pronunciation.text: The information is managed at the CXO level.
pronunciation.hint_cn: at the level 是固定搭配，CXO 按字母读。

core: Let me try to get it.
meaning_cn: 我来试着获取一下；我来想办法拿到这个信息。
explanation_cn: Let me try to... 是自然的口语/商务表达，表示主动尝试做某事。get it 在具体语境中可以指拿到信息、文件或反馈。
source_sentence: Let me try to get it.

examples.en: Let me try to get the latest data.
examples.cn: 我来试着拿到最新数据。

examples.en: Let me try to confirm it with the customer.
examples.cn: 我来试着和客户确认一下。

pronunciation.text: Let me try to get it.
pronunciation.hint_cn: Let me 常弱读连起来，try to 可连读。

core: tipped back
meaning_cn: 向后倾斜；向后翘起
explanation_cn: tip 作动词时表示使某物倾斜。chair tipped back 指椅子前腿离地或椅背向后靠，整把椅子处于后仰状态。这里描写的是他把椅子往后翘，后背靠着墙坐着。
source_sentence: He is sitting with his chair tipped back, his back against the wall.

examples.en: He sat with his chair tipped back against the wall.
examples.cn: 他把椅子往后翘，靠着墙坐。

examples.en: Don't tip your chair back. You might fall.
examples.cn: 别把椅子往后翘，你可能会摔倒。

pronunciation.text: tipped back
pronunciation.hint_cn: tipped 的 -ed 读 /t/ 的感觉，back 要读清楚。

core: playground
meaning_cn: 游乐场；操场；活动或试验的场所
explanation_cn: playground 最常见是儿童游乐场或学校操场。引申时也可表示供人自由尝试、实验或发挥的环境，例如 software playground 指用于测试想法的试验环境。
source_sentence: Playground什么意思

examples.en: The children are playing in the playground.
examples.cn: 孩子们正在游乐场玩。

examples.en: This tool is a playground for testing new ideas.
examples.cn: 这个工具是用来测试新想法的试验环境。

pronunciation.text: playground
pronunciation.hint_cn: play 和 ground 连读，重音通常在 play。

core: Celsia is gaining market share in peripheral areas.
meaning_cn: Celsia 在城市边缘区域的市场份额正在增长。
explanation_cn: 在商业分析里，gain market share 比 market share grows 更自然，因为主语是运营商，强调它正在获得更多份额。peripheral areas 表示城市或区域的边缘地带，适合描述地理位置；不要写 at the edge of the market，因为那更容易被理解为“处于市场边缘/非主流位置”，而不是城市边缘区域。
source_sentence: Celsia is gaining market share in peripheral areas.

examples.en: Celsia is gaining market share in peripheral areas.
examples.cn: Celsia 在城市边缘区域的市场份额正在增长。

examples.en: The operator is gaining share in suburban and peripheral areas.
examples.cn: 该运营商正在郊区和城市边缘区域提升市场份额。

examples.en: Most of Celsia's advantage is concentrated in peripheral parts of the city.
examples.cn: Celsia 的主要优势集中在城市边缘区域。

pronunciation.text: Celsia is gaining market share in peripheral areas.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 gaining market share 和 peripheral areas；peripheral 可按 pe-RI-pheral 的节奏分块练习。

core: Claro's net subscriber growth is fully driven by FTTH.
meaning_cn: Claro 的净增用户增长完全由 FTTH 驱动。
explanation_cn: 在商业汇报中，be driven by 用于说明某个结果的主要驱动因素。fully driven by 强调该结果几乎或完全来自单一因素，比 FTTH contributes to growth 更强。这里用 net subscriber growth 表达“净增用户增长”，适合运营商用户发展分析。
source_sentence: Claro’s net subscriber growth is fully driven by FTTH

examples.en: Claro's net subscriber growth is fully driven by FTTH.
examples.cn: Claro 的净增用户增长完全由 FTTH 驱动。

examples.en: Recent subscriber growth is largely driven by fiber migration.
examples.cn: 近期用户增长主要由光纤迁转驱动。

examples.en: Revenue growth is increasingly driven by higher-value plans.
examples.cn: 收入增长越来越多地由高价值套餐驱动。

pronunciation.text: Claro's net subscriber growth is fully driven by FTTH.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 net subscriber growth、fully driven 和 FTTH；driven by 连读自然，不要逐词停顿。

core: In the 350–400 Mbps segment, Celsia offers faster speeds at a lower price.
meaning_cn: 在 350–400 Mbps 档位，Celsia 以更低价格提供更高速度。
explanation_cn: 比较级 faster 本身已经表示“更快”，不能说 more faster。描述价格优势时，用 at a lower price 比直接说 lower price 更自然。商务/PPT 表达中，可用 offers faster speeds at a lower price 同时概括速度和价格优势。
source_sentence: In 350-400M segment, Celsia is more faster and lower price

examples.en: In the 350–400 Mbps segment, Celsia offers faster speeds at a lower price.
examples.cn: 在 350–400 Mbps 档位，Celsia 以更低价格提供更高速度。

examples.en: This plan offers more bandwidth at a lower price.
examples.cn: 这个套餐以更低价格提供更高带宽。

examples.en: Celsia is faster and more competitively priced in this segment.
examples.cn: 在这一档位，Celsia 速度更快，价格也更有竞争力。

pronunciation.text: In the 350–400 Mbps segment, Celsia offers faster speeds at a lower price.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 faster speeds、lower price 和 350–400 Mbps segment；at a lower price 连读自然。

core: Grid presence is based on observed broadband samples and does not represent physical network coverage.
meaning_cn: 网格中的运营商存在情况基于观测到的宽带样本，并不代表实际物理网络覆盖。
explanation_cn: 在数据分析和客户汇报中，当样本只能证明某运营商在网格中被观测到时，不应直接把它表述为物理网络 coverage。is based on 用于说明判断依据，does not represent 用于明确限制结论边界，适合方法说明和页脚免责声明。
source_sentence: Grid presence is based on observed broadband samples and does not represent physical network coverage.

examples.en: Grid presence is based on observed broadband samples and does not represent physical network coverage.
examples.cn: 网格中的运营商存在情况基于观测到的宽带样本，并不代表实际物理网络覆盖。

examples.en: This estimate is based on observed samples and does not represent the full customer base.
examples.cn: 这一估算基于观测样本，并不代表全部客户群体。

examples.en: The result indicates observed presence rather than confirmed network coverage.
examples.cn: 该结果反映的是观测到的存在情况，而不是已确认的网络覆盖。

pronunciation.text: Grid presence is based on observed broadband samples and does not represent physical network coverage.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 based on、observed broadband samples、does not represent 和 physical network coverage；does not represent 可连贯表达限制边界。

core: For Palmira, expansion should be the first priority, followed by migration.
meaning_cn: 对于 Palmira，扩建应作为第一优先级，其次是迁转。
explanation_cn: 在客户汇报中表达两个动作的先后顺序，可以用 the first priority, followed by ...。这个结构比 first we do A, second we do B 更简洁、更适合 PPT 和口头汇报。followed by 后接第二优先事项。
source_sentence: Palmira优先1是扩建，2是迁转

examples.en: For Palmira, expansion should be the first priority, followed by migration.
examples.cn: 对于 Palmira，扩建应作为第一优先级，其次是迁转。

examples.en: For Tuluá, migration should come first, followed by expansion.
examples.cn: 对于 Tuluá，应优先迁转，其次扩建。

examples.en: Customer retention should be the first priority, followed by upselling.
examples.cn: 客户保有应作为第一优先级，其次是升套。

pronunciation.text: For Palmira, expansion should be the first priority, followed by migration.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 expansion、first priority、followed by 和 migration；followed by 连起来读会更自然。

core: For Ibagué and Candelaria, market share is lower but growth is faster, so expansion can help add more subscribers.
meaning_cn: 对于 Ibagué 和 Candelaria，市场份额较低但增长更快，因此扩建可以帮助增加更多用户。
explanation_cn: 客户汇报中可以用 lower but faster 简单对比两个指标，再用 so 直接引出策略。can help add more subscribers 比 unlock subscriber growth 更直白，适合英语水平一般的客户交流。
source_sentence: Ibagué、Candelaria 都是低份额、增长稍快的城市，考虑扩建增加用户。

examples.en: For Ibagué and Candelaria, market share is lower but growth is faster, so expansion can help add more subscribers.
examples.cn: 对于 Ibagué 和 Candelaria，市场份额较低但增长更快，因此扩建可以帮助增加更多用户。

examples.en: Market share is lower, but user growth is faster in these cities.
examples.cn: 这些城市的市场份额较低，但用户增长更快。

examples.en: Expansion can help us add more subscribers in low-share areas.
examples.cn: 在低份额区域，扩建可以帮助我们增加更多用户。

pronunciation.text: For Ibagué and Candelaria, market share is lower but growth is faster, so expansion can help add more subscribers.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 market share、lower、growth、faster、expansion 和 add more subscribers；lower but growth is faster 可连贯表达对比。

core: For Buga, churn is high, so migration should come first.
meaning_cn: 对于 Buga，用户流失较高，因此应优先迁转。
explanation_cn: 在运营商客户汇报中，churn 可直接表示用户流失；come first 是自然且简洁的优先级表达。用 so 连接问题和动作，比 therefore 或 should be prioritized 更口语、更适合英语水平一般的客户交流。
source_sentence: Buga 流失高，建议优先迁转。

examples.en: For Buga, churn is high, so migration should come first.
examples.cn: 对于 Buga，用户流失较高，因此应优先迁转。

examples.en: Churn is high in this area, so customer retention should come first.
examples.cn: 这个区域的用户流失较高，因此应优先做客户保有。

examples.en: The FTTH share is still low, so migration should come first.
examples.cn: FTTH 占比仍然较低，因此应优先迁转。

pronunciation.text: For Buga, churn is high, so migration should come first.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 Buga、churn、high、migration 和 come first；so 前后轻停顿，突出问题到策略的逻辑。

core: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
meaning_cn: 让我先整理一下思路，之后可能还需要你帮我一起检查一下。
explanation_cn: organize my thoughts 是自然的“整理思路”表达；may need your help to ... 用于礼貌地提前说明后续可能需要对方协助。review everything later 比 check it later 更适合材料、思路或方案尚未完全确定的场景。
source_sentence: 等我整理下思路，我可能需要你帮我检查一下。

examples.en: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
examples.cn: 让我先整理一下思路，之后可能还需要你帮我一起检查一下。

examples.en: Let me organize my thoughts first, then I'll send you a clearer version.
examples.cn: 让我先整理一下思路，然后我会发你一个更清晰的版本。

examples.en: I may need your help to review the deck once I have the structure ready.
examples.cn: 等我把结构整理好后，可能需要你帮我一起检查这份材料。

pronunciation.text: Let me organize my thoughts first, and I may need your help to review everything later.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 organize my thoughts、need your help、review 和 later；Let me 和 I may need 可自然连读，整体语气保持轻松、礼貌。
